games.name: Tank Rails [Alpha]
games.desc:
Tank Rails 🛡️🚂

The tank is your ultimate weapon. The zombie apocalypse has taken over, and you're racing against time to get to safety. Hop into the tank on the rail and fight off hordes of zombies, but be careful—your tank is vulnerable and can take damage! Scavenge for resources during your journey to repair and upgrade your tank as you battle through relentless zombie waves. Will you survive the undead onslaught and make it to the end before it's too late?

Like the game! ❤️❤️

Gameplay:

🚀 Upgrade & Defend the Tank
💥 Fight Off Zombies & Survive
🛠️ Scavenge for Resources to Repair the Tank
⚔️ Team Up or Go Solo
💰 Loot & Upgrade

PC controls:

M to unlock cursor
Shift to rotate items

Like, Favorite & join the group for updates! 👍

5,000 likes for the next update!

Inspired by Dead Rails : D

games.name: 💎 Rarity Miner [Tycoon] ⛏️
games.desc:
⛏️ Welcome to Rarity Miner ⛏️

[How to Mine] 💎
• Equip your pickaxe near the bottom of your screen
• Hold down your mouse on nearby rocks, especially ones with rare ores!
• Then it's up to you to decide to save your ores for upgrades, or sell them for cash!
• Exclusive enchants can be found deep in the mines within chests and equipped for unique buffs

💎 Play with friends to receive +10% XP per friend in your server!
⭐ Please report any potential bugs to the developers! v1.53.0
